2026-10-30GACOther Than Statutory AuthorityOrder Ratifying the Final Acts of the International Telecommunication Union Plenipotentiary Conference, Doha 2026Order authorizing the Prime Minister, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, or a delegate, to sign, on behalf of the Government of Canada, subject to ratification, the Final Acts of the International Telecommunication Union Plenipotentiary Conference to be held at the Doha in November 2026.N/A
subject: Order Ratifying the Final Acts of the International Telecommunication Union Plenipotentiary Conference, Doha 2026
precis: Order authorizing the Prime Minister, the Minister of Foreign Affairs, or a delegate, to sign, on behalf of the Government of Canada, subject to ratification, the Final Acts of the International Telecommunication Union Plenipotentiary Conference to be held at the Doha in November 2026.
